spans.s: चोल (I) m. pl. Name of a country in Southern India, the modern Tanjore.
चोल (II) m. A short jacket, a bodice, e.g. चोलच्छत्रा यदि कुचतटी दुर्लभा गुर्जरीणाम् Mukundānanda.
चोलक m. 1. A breastplate; 2. a bark-dress.
चोलकिन् m. 1. A soldier armed with a breast-plate; 2. the orange tree.
चोलंडुक m. A fillet for the head, a turban.
